item.title: Adverse Weather Alert Discontinuation - Green Level
item.description: The atmosphere has now stabilized, and the threat of impactful weather has significantly reduced. Keep in mind that a few periods of showers and isolated thunderstorms are still possible overnight, as the Tropical wave moves through the region.
item.dc:creator: Trinidad and Tobago Meteorological Service Synoptic Branch

item.title: Adverse Weather Alert #1 - Yellow Level
item.description: There is a potential for the combination of local dynamics and a tropical wave to produce impactful weather during the afternoon. The most impactful weather will likely favour western areas of Trinidad, however showers and isolated thunderstorms are
